rules.law_name: San Francisco Allowable Annual Rent Increase
rules.title: 2026-2027 allowable annual rent increase
rules.requirement: For the March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 period, the allowable rent increase listed by the San Francisco Rent Board is 1.6%.

coverage.summary: The document does not state which San Francisco tenancies or buildings are covered by this allowable rent increase rate.

rules.title: Relocation payments for specified no-fault evictions
rules.requirement: For eviction notices served from March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 for owner/relative move-in, demolition or permanent removal from housing use, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation, the listed relocation payment is $8,245 per tenant, capped at $24,733 per unit. An additional $5,497 is due for each elderly tenant age 60 or older, disabled tenant, or household with minor children.
rules.key_value: $8,245 per tenant; $24,733 maximum per unit; plus $5,497 for each elderly, disabled, or household with minor child(ren)

coverage.other_unresolvable: Applies to evictions based on owner/relative move-in, demolition or permanent removal of the unit from housing use, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation; additional payments depend on tenant age, disability, or household with minor children.
coverage.summary: The document describes relocation payments for San Francisco tenants evicted for specified no-fault reasons, with extra payments for elderly or disabled tenants or households with minor children.

rules.exemptions: Temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days are governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9, not Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.
rules.interaction: The document states that temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days are governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.

rules.law_name: Rent Ordinance Section 37.9A Ellis Act relocation payments
rules.title: Relocation payments for Ellis Act evictions
rules.requirement: For eviction notices served from March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 for tenants evicted under the Ellis Act, the listed relocation payment is $11,110.05 per tenant, capped at $33,330.13 per unit. An additional $7,443.90 is due for each elderly tenant age 62 or older or disabled tenant.
rules.key_value: $11,110.05 per tenant; $33,330.13 maximum per unit; plus $7,443.90 for each elderly or disabled tenant

coverage.other_unresolvable: Applies to tenants evicted under the Ellis Act; additional payments depend on whether a tenant is elderly age 62 or older or disabled.
coverage.summary: The document describes relocation payments for San Francisco tenants evicted under the Ellis Act.

rules.law_name: California Civil Code Section 1947.9 temporary displacement relocation payments
rules.title: Relocation payments for temporary displacement under 20 days
rules.requirement: For eviction notices served from March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 involving temporary displacement for less than 20 days, the listed relocation payment is $446 per day per tenant household plus actual moving expenses.
rules.key_value: $446.00/day per tenant household plus actual moving expenses

coverage.other_unresolvable: Applies to temporary displacement for less than 20 days, including temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days as described in the document.
coverage.summary: The document describes payments for tenant households temporarily displaced for less than 20 days.

rules.interaction: The document states that temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days are governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by San Francisco Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.
